verdict.rationale: Vendor docs describe the RTX PRO 6000 as a workstation/desktop GPU (PCIe Gen5, 96GB GDDR7, DisplayPort, multi-monitor bandwidth) with no mention of NVLink, Infinity Fabric, or rack-scale multi-GPU interconnect; the only shared-architecture claim is a compute engine (FP8 Transformer Engine) 'shared with data center-class Blackwell GPUs,' not an interconnect fabric. Community evidence of 4-card builds shows standard PCIe workstation configs with power/cooling hacks (water-blocking, 2.4kW circuits) and explicit complaints that this SM120 part 'lacks tmem/tcgen05 and support in main libraries' compared to true datacenter Blackwell (B300/SM100), confirming it is not built or documented for datacenter-scale interconnect or rack deployment.
